title: Fugue VIII — guided listening
scope: Exact-score excerpts. Solo examples retain timbres, notes and timing; excerpt levels are normalized for clarity.

segments.title: Three ideas, nine players
segments.text: Learn the chant, the dance and the rising companion. Then compare isolated exchanges with the complete ensemble.

segments.title: The chant — horn
segments.text: A measured tune with a small fall and a repeated final note. Remember its contour.

segments.title: The dance interrupts
segments.text: Its accents divide the opening bar into 3 + 3 + 2 eighth notes. The second bar changes the shape.

segments.title: The dance — bassoon
segments.text: The long-short articulation and displaced accents give this idea a different gait from the chant.

segments.title: The rising companion — viola
segments.text: A broad rise reaches its high point, then turns down. This third idea will move between instruments.

segments.title: Three lines together
segments.text: The oboe answers the chant. The viola rises beneath it while the horn continues its own sentence.

segments.title: Follow the long phrases
segments.text: First hear three paths from the first dense paragraph. Then hear the same passage with all nine parts.

segments.title: Flute, clarinet and bass
segments.text: The flute descends, the clarinet works upward, and the bass carries the chant. Their phrase lengths differ.

segments.title: Restore the nine parts
segments.text: Follow one of those paths through the surrounding dance heads, held notes and continuations.

segments.title: The texture opens
segments.text: The relative-major arrival releases the first dense paragraph. Fewer lines leave room around each new entrance.

segments.title: A chromatic slip travels downward
segments.text: Viola, horn and bassoon pass F–F-flat–E-flat through three registers, with unequal delays.

segments.title: The slip inside the ensemble
segments.text: The same three lines now sit inside the longer phrases around them. Trace the inner colors.

segments.title: The low dance chase
segments.text: Horn, bass and cello enter one beat apart with the dance head, then take different continuations.

segments.title: Two speeds collide
segments.text: Restore all nine parts. The flute and violin hurry the chant above the low chase; other lines keep a broader pace.

segments.title: The quiet memory
segments.text: After the cadence resolves, the cello begins the chant at twice its original note lengths. The texture thins sharply.

segments.title: The major return keeps developing
segments.text: The last convergence continues beyond the change to major. Follow the different phrase peaks as the passage grows.

segments.title: The final cadence
segments.text: The lines close into the last turn home. A shared ending is the destination of the preceding movement.
